source.name: Regenerated unexplained-metaphor development
source.notes: All thirty approved pilot cases retain their exact text, IDs, labels and snippets. Quality-rejected drafts are replaced under fresh IDs; blind review and adjudications are recorded separately. One valid control was later replaced under a fresh ID after independent cross-split overlap review; its text and provenance remain archived as an overlap exclusion.
